annotations.note: FY25 rev $3,802m, EBITDA $974m (-23% YoY), NPAT $368m; Moody's Baa2 Negative Nov-26.
Moody's affirmed EQUATE at Baa2 in Nov 2026 and changed outlook to Negative from Stable due to weak global petrochemical margins and leverage metrics; $1.25bn 4.25% notes matured Nov-26.
Producer is positioned in the bottom quartile (Q1) of global production costs, preserving positive EBITDA generation across cyclical commodity troughs.
>75% of revenues billed in USD/EUR against predominantly local-currency operating expenditures, creating a structural natural FX hedge.
Controls world-class mineral or petrochemical reserves essential to the domestic economy, ensuring sovereign backstop support in stress scenarios.

verdict.stance: Underweight / IG Spread Compression vs Petrochemical Trough (Baa2 Neg Moody's)
verdict.summary: EQUATE's FY25 EBITDA fell 23.3% YoY to $974m ($368m NI on $3.80bn rev) under global ethylene glycol/polyethylene trough spreads, prompting Moody's in Nov-26 to affirm Baa2 with a Negative outlook. Advantaged KPC ethane feedstock and full plant utilization anchor IG status, but leverage headroom has narrowed.

positives: Access to advantaged low-cost Kuwaiti ethane feedstock via PIC (KPC subsidiary) and technology/offtake from Dow.
Investment-grade ratings maintained (Moody's Baa2 Neg / S&P BBB) with strong institutional sukuk/EMTN market access.
Disciplined supply and cost optimization during chemical downcycle.
negatives: Moody's revised outlook to Negative in Nov 2026 citing weak global petrochemical margins (MEG/PE) and elevated leverage.
Refinancing/repayment execution around $1.25bn Nov-2026 maturity (XS1513739760) amidst tighter chemical cash flows.
US/global MEG capacity overhang (including MEGlobal Oyster Creek) weighing on spreads.

background.business_overview: Kuwait-based global petrochemical JV (EG, PE, PET) jointly owned by Petrochemical Industries Co (PIC/KPC, 42.5%), Dow Chemical (42.5%), and Kuwaiti partners.
background.asset_perimeter: Shuaiba Kuwait complexes plus MEGlobal assets in Canada and US Gulf Coast.
background.ownership_governance: Strategic JV of KPC (state) and Dow; $2bn EQUATE Sukuk SPC & EMTN programs.
